'''2002 Modesto Blast From the Past''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Kriers, Modesto, California on 2 February 2002. [[Clayton Atkin]] won it. It is known from Clayton Atkin's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d3332">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2002-02-05-blast-from-the-past-modesto-2-2d3332/ blast-from-the-past-modesto-2-2], DeckTech (Clayton "TheDohMan" Atkin, 5 February 2002). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2002-02-05-blast-from-the-past-modesto-2-2d3332/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 2 February 2002
* '''Site:''' Kriers, Modesto, California
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - A New Hope]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Clayton Atkin]]
